text:
**continue**: land A1 (`a1-install-cmd-skips-linked-git-worktrees-s`) onto `main`, proceed with A2 (`a2-point-launch-line-and-kit-orchestrator-t`), and when ready to switch the live `board` launcher off `board-streamline`, fast-forward `/home/anon/board` and run `python3 -I install.py . --update` from that main checkout so `~/.local/bin/board` points back to `main`.

## Holds
All reruns and `breaks` mutations were executed in a temporary detached scratch worktree `/tmp/review-a1` at `origin/a1` (`bceab4b`, removed after verification; `/home/anon/board-a1`, `/home/anon/board-m9`, and `/home/anon/board-streamline` were never edited):

- **Check rerun (`check`):**
  - `python3 -m unittest tests.test_install_worktree_cmd tests.test_install_update -v </dev/null`: **Ran 8 tests in 18.305s, OK** (`tests.test_install_worktree_cmd` 6/6, `tests.test_install_update` 2/2).
  - `python3 -I test_install.py </dev/null`: **0 failed** (every check passed, including temp-folder skip and `KIT_BIN_DIR` override; note `< /dev/null` is needed under a PTY because `test_install.py` invokes `install.py` without `stdin=DEVNULL` while `ask_yes_no()` checks `sys.stdin.isatty()`).
  - `python3 -m unittest tests.test_kit_copies_current -v </dev/null`: **Ran 2 tests in 0.165s, OK**.
- **`breaks` (`revert`):** Reverted `install.py` to `origin/main` in `/tmp/review-a1` and ran `python3 -m unittest tests.test_install_worktree_cmd -v </dev/null` -> **FAILED (failures=2, errors=2)** in 6.224s:
  - `IsGitWorktreeTests` errored (`AttributeError: module 'kit_install_a1' has no attribute 'is_git_worktree'`).
  - `test_linked_worktree_skips_default_bin_and_leaves_existing_launcher_untouched` failed because `install_cmd()` overwrote the existing launcher with `exec "/tmp/.../linked-wt/.kit/up" "$@"` (and emitted `ResourceWarning` on unclosed `dst`).
  - `test_install_update_subprocess_in_worktree_preserves_launchers_and_respects_override` failed asserting `'is a git worktree'`.
  - Restored `install.py` to `origin/a1` and reran `tests.test_install_worktree_cmd` -> **Ran 6 tests in 8.408s, OK**.
- **Edge cases (main checkout vs linked git worktree vs subdir inside linked worktree vs symlinks vs `KIT_BIN_DIR`):**
  - Direct checks against live checkouts using `/tmp/review-a1/install.py`: `is_git_worktree()` returned `False` for `/home/anon/board`, `/home/anon/board/tests`, `/home/anon/harmonize`, and a symlink to `/home/anon/board`; and returned `True` (`under_tempdir() == False`) for `/home/anon/board-a1`, `/home/anon/board-a1/tests` (subdir without `.git`, caught by `git rev-parse --git-dir --git-common-dir`), `/home/anon/board-streamline`, `/home/anon/board-streamline/tests`, and a symlink to `/home/anon/board-a1`.
  - `install_cmd('/home/anon/board-a1', 'board', dry=True, ...)` logged `SKIPPED command \`board\`: /home/anon/board-a1 is a git worktree (set KIT_BIN_DIR to install its launcher)` when `KIT_BIN_DIR` was unset or `""`, and targeted the override dir when `KIT_BIN_DIR` was set.
  - Live worktree dry-runs on `/home/anon/board-a1` and `/home/anon/board-streamline` (`install.py <dir> --update --dry-run`) both exited `0` and printed the `SKIPPED command \`board\`: ... is a git worktree` line.
- **Real-project check (K2):** Reran `python3 -I /home/anon/board-a1/install.py /home/anon/harmonize --update --dry-run` -> **exit 0**, kept `kit.claude_permission_mode: best`, simulated `docs/board/harmonize-board.html`, and left `/home/anon/harmonize` and `~/.local/bin` untouched.
- **Owner's `asked` (`a1b2d992af8d48c8af39`):**
  - Inspected `/home/anon/.local/bin/board` (mtime `2026-11-27 02:26:21 -05:00`): it contains `exec "/home/anon/board-streamline/.kit/up" "$@"`. `/home/anon/board-streamline` is a linked git worktree (`feat/streamline-doctor-memory`, `.git` common dir `/home/anon/board/.git`) outside `/tmp`, so `install_cmd()`'s previous `under_tempdir(t)` check did not prevent `install.py . --update` from overwriting the launcher.
  - Note: on disk right now, `~/.local/bin/board` still points to `/home/anon/board-streamline/.kit/up` (where the live board server `PID 10768` and clerk are running, while `/home/anon/board` is still at `473dea4`). A1 stops future worktree runs from overwriting `~/.local/bin/<cmd>`; re-pointing `~/.local/bin/board` to a main checkout still requires running `install.py` from that main checkout when ready.
- **What was not checked:** Verified A1's `not_checked` note by running `tests.test_install_present_runtimes` (`FAILED (failures=1)` on `test_stale_claude_hooks_refreshed_under_cli_agy` expecting `kit_queue_stop.py` omitted, pre-existing on `origin/main`). Did not run `scripts/run_all_tests.py` (kept RAM light per review instructions), `tests.test_install_permissions`, or `tests.test_new_install`.

## Goal
- **End goal vs current measure:** Train `agy` aligns Antigravity-runner behavior and tooling with `kit.py`. For A1, preventing linked-worktree installs/updates from breaking the owner's one-word `~/.local/bin/<cmd>` launcher is directly measured by `tests.test_install_worktree_cmd`, live worktree dry-runs, and the Harmonize dry-run (not a proxy).
- **Known-good case:** Real main checkouts (`/home/anon/board`, `/home/anon/harmonize`), real linked worktrees (`/home/anon/board-a1`, `/home/anon/board-streamline`), and a full subprocess `--update` preserving pre-existing `myproj` and `board` launchers all pass.
- **Owner's last try:** A1 is the first Done step of train `agy` (1 Done since `a1b2d992af8d48c8af39`, under the 3-Done threshold). As noted above, `~/.local/bin/board` itself will remain pointed at `/home/anon/board-streamline/.kit/up` until `install.py` is run from a main checkout.
- **Across the posts:** Train `agy` holds A1 (complete) and A2 (`a2-point-launch-line-and-kit-orchestrator-t`, planned follow-up from `CR-r7-r4-combined` touching `scripts/kit.py`, `kit/orchestrator.template.md`, and `tests/test_launch_runtime.py`). No contradiction or file conflict with A1.

## Verdict
**continue** — A1's `is_git_worktree` detection, `install_cmd` skip/override logic, 6 worktree tests, and Harmonize dry-run all hold and fail cleanly on `revert`. Land `a1-install-cmd-skips-linked-git-worktrees-s` onto `main`, move on to A2, and re-run `install.py . --update` from an up-to-date main checkout (`/home/anon/board`) when switching the live `board` launcher off `board-streamline`.
